adversarial_fault_injection.detail: Host C tests cover transient I2C/SPI/TX recovery, CRC rejection, bounded SX1262 BUSY wait, TX/RX IRQ deadlines, and deterministic reset-flag classification. The Zephyr target build configures the MCU watchdog, but reset behavior is not physically executed. Analog power faults require electrical models; unexpected reboot needs a persistent expected-reset contract
